verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows ROS 2 can launch simulations (Gazebo) and record/playback data via rosbag, but contains no documentation or evidence of automated testing frameworks (e.g., colcon test, launch_testing), CI pipeline integration, or simulation-based regression testing workflows. Without concrete evidence of a CI-oriented test harness or regression-testing tooling, the story is unevidenced even though the axis clearly applies to a robotics middleware/deployment story.
